Craft-labelled posts stayed under the median: the three craft posts in the window (5.2s at 0.9x, 8.6s at 0.7x, 72.8s at 0.6x) all came in below the 5,046-view median, and the one story post at 0.1x was the weakest of the window. Craft needs a joke or reveal in the first second to reach people.
